blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically trained by behavior cloning and thus do not explicitly optimize long-term task return. Critic guidance steers generation toward higher-value actions, but existing methods differentiate the critic through a one-step surrogate of the sampler and back-propagate a critic ensemble at every flow step.
In contrast, here we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight guidance network while preserving the pretrained VLA policy.
Specifically, we formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, whose optimal guidance is a costate that carries the terminal critic gradient back through the remaining flow, and regress the guidance network onto this costate while keeping both the VLA and critic frozen.
This design provides favorable memory and throughput scaling during training, and inference needs one guidance-network forward pass per step, without the critic ensemble, back-propagation, or adjoint computation.
Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF consistently improves pretrained VLAs, remains competitive with critic-guidance and policy-fine-tuning baselines, and is the most robust method when a single guidance strength is deployed across tasks.
Compared with QGF, AGF runs 3.6 × 3.6\times faster per guidance step with 7.0 × 7.0\times fewer parameters, with comparable and even better performance, showing that critic guidance can be trajectory-aware and lightweight. Project page: https://jeongsol-kim.github.io/agf/project_page/

基于流程的Vision-Language-Action(VLA)政策通常通过行为克隆进行训练,因此没有明确优化长期任务回报. 批评指导引导生成转向高值动作,但现有方法通过对采样器的一步代位来区分批评者,并在每一流程步骤中背向评论者组合.
与此相对照,我们在此提议联合指导流程(AGF),将有轨迹感的批评者指导分期摊还到轻量级指导网络中,同时保留预先训练的VLA政策.
具体地说,我们把批评者引导的流量生成作为一个决定性的最佳控制问题,其最佳的引导是将终端评论者梯度带回剩余流量的计算成本,并将引导网络倒退到这个计算成本上,同时将VLA和批评者都冻结。
这种设计在训练期间提供了有利的内存和吞吐量的缩放,推论每步需要一个导线-网络前传,没有评论者综艺,反传播,或联合计算.
在整个LIBERO、RoboCasa和LIBERO-Pro,AGF不断改进经过预先培训的VLA,在批评指导和政策精细调整基线方面仍然具有竞争力,并且是跨任务部署单一指导力量时最有力的方法。
与QGF相比,AGF在每个制导步骤上运行3.6×3.6\时速度更快,7.0×7.0\时参数较少,性能可比较甚至更好,表明批评者制导可以有轨迹意识和轻量级. 项目网页:https://jeongsol-kim.github.io/agf/project_page/

blocks.en:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for learning general-purpose robot policies by leveraging the rich visual and semantic representations of vision-language models (VLMs) ( Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ) .
Given visual observations and language instructions, VLAs aim to generate temporally coherent action for accomplishing diverse manipulation tasks, often predicted in chunks ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ) .
A central challenge in robot policy learning is the inherently multimodal distribution of feasible actions ( Mandlekar et al., 2022 ) : regression-based behavior cloning can average across modes, producing actions that match no demonstrated behavior ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Florence et al., 2022 ) . Diffusion and flow policies address this by modeling the conditional action distribution through iterative generation ( Chi et al., 2025 ) , but typically rely on task-specific visual representations without the broad semantic understanding of pretrained VLMs.
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言-行动模型最近成为学习通用机器人政策的有希望的范例,利用视觉-语言模型丰富的视觉和语义表现(VLMs)(Zitkovich等人,2023年;Kim等人,2024年;Intelligence等人,2025年)。
鉴于目视观察和语言指示,志愿军旨在产生时间上一致的行动,以完成各种操纵任务,这些任务往往以块数预测(Zhao等人,2023年;Intelligence等人,2025年)。
机器人政策学习中的一项核心挑战是可行行动的内在多模式分布(Mandlekar等人,2022年):基于回归的行为克隆可以跨模式平均,产生与未显示的行为相符的行动(Zhang等人,2018年;Florence等人,2022年)。 扩散和流政策通过迭代生成(Chi等人,2025年)模拟有条件的动作分布来解决这个问题,但通常依赖任务特定的视觉表现,而没有对预先训练的VLM的广泛语义理解.

blocks.en:
Recent VLA models combine the two: rather than discretizing actions into tokens as in OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , which can interfere with the VLM’s pretrained representations, they pair a pretrained VLM with a diffusion- or flow-based action expert that models the continuous action distribution ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Shukor et al., 2025 ; Bjorck et al., 2025 ) .
Despite their expressive action distributions, these policies are commonly trained with behavior cloning ( Chi et al., 2025 ) , which neither optimizes task return nor distinguishes high-value actions from actions that are merely likely under the demonstrations ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Psenka et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
Recent works therefore incorporate a learned critic of long-term utility, either adapting the policy toward high-value actions through additional training ( Doo et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or keeping it fixed and applying critic guidance during generation, such as QGF ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , which steers each generation step with critic gradients ( Ruan et al., 2026 ) .
The former does not require the critic during inference, but requires additional policy optimization for the downstream task, whereas inference-time guidance can incorporate task-specific value information while preserving the pretrained generative policy.
blocks.zh:
近期的VLA模型结合了两者:而不是像OpenVLA(Kim等人,2024年)那样将动作编成符号,这可能会干扰VLM预先训练的表达,而是将一个经过预先训练的VLM与一个以扩散或流动为基础的行动专家配对,以模拟连续动作分配(Intelligence等人,2025年;Shukor等人,2025年;Bjorck等人,2025年)。
尽管其表现性动作分布,这些政策通常都接受行为克隆(Chi等人,2025年)的训练,既未优化任务返回,也未区分高值动作与在示威下仅仅可能采取的行动(Wang等人,2023年;Psenka等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年).
因此,近期的作品包含了一位具有长期效用的有学问的批评家,或者通过额外的培训来调整政策,以采取高价值的行动(Doo等人,2026年;Shi等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年),或者在一代人的时间里保持固定和运用批评家的指导,如QGF(Zhou等人,2026年),它用批评家的梯度来指导每一代人的步骤(Ruan等人,2026年)。
前者在推论时不需要评论者,而是需要为下游任务进行更多的政策优化,而推论时间指导可以纳入特定任务的价值信息,同时保留预先训练的基因政策.

blocks.en:
However, existing inference-time critic-guidance methods ( Zhou et al., 2026 ; Ruan et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) suffer from two main limitations. First, they differentiate the critic only at the Tweedie estimate, a one-step surrogate of the sampler, and thus ignore how the remaining flow shapes the executed action.
Second, they require repeated critic back-propagation at every generation step, whose cost is further amplified when a critic ensemble is used for conservative value estimation.
Fine-tuning approaches such as adjoint matching ( Domingo-Enrich et al., 2025 ) and QAM ( Li and Levine, 2026 ) avoid the critic at inference by amortizing adjoint supervision into the policy itself, but require policy back-propagation and modify its weights for each downstream task.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的推论-评论-指导方法(周等人,2026年;鲁安等人,2026年;杨等人,2026年)受到两大限制. 首先,它们只在Tweedie估计中区分批评者,即采样者的一步代位,从而忽略了剩余流如何塑造被执行的动作.
其次,它们要求每代人都反复进行评论反向传播,当一个评论家综艺节目用于保守价值估计时,其成本会进一步扩大.
联合匹配(Domingo-Enrich等人,2025年)和QAM(Li和Levine,2026年)等精细调整方法,通过将联合监管分期摊入政策本身来避免批评者推论,但需要政策反向推广,并修改每项下游任务的权重.

blocks.en:
To bridge these alternatives, we propose Adjoint Guidance Flow (AGF), which amortizes trajectory-wise critic adjoints into a separate, lightweight guidance network.
We formulate critic-guided flow generation as a deterministic optimal control problem, where the optimal guidance at each flow step is a costate: the sensitivity of the final critic value to the current intermediate action through all remaining flow steps.
We then train the guidance network to directly predict this costate from intermediate flow states.
Once trained, AGF guides the frozen policy with a single guidance-network forward pass, without the critic ensemble or modifying the pretrained policy (Table 1 ); compared with QGF, this is 3.6 × 3.6\times faster per guidance step with 7.0 × 7.0\times fewer parameters. Our contributions are summarized as follows. • To guide a frozen VLA without evaluating or back-propagating the critic at inference, we propose AGF, which amortizes trajectory-aware critic guidance into a lightweight network. • We characterize the optimal guidance as the costate of a deterministic optimal control problem and regress the guidance network onto costates computed along its own trajectories, smoothed by particle-averaged Jacobians whose noise adds no bias for any number of particles. • Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro with three flow-based VLAs and on a real robot, AGF improves every pretrained policy, remains competitive with critic guidance and policy fine-tuning, and keeps its gains under one shared strength.

The adjoint target in Eq. ( 13 ) depends on the flow Jacobian J t ​ ( 𝒂 t ) J_{t}({\bm{a}}_{t}) , which provides the exact local sensitivity along a given trajectory but can vary substantially across nearby intermediate actions in neural flow models.
Small changes in the guided trajectory can therefore perturb the adjoint targets, which is particularly relevant under on-policy refinement, where successive updates of the guidance network continuously shift the intermediate action trajectory.
To obtain a more locally regularized sensitivity estimate, we perturb each intermediate action with Gaussian particles, 𝒂 t , m = 𝒂 t + σ ​ ϵ m {\bm{a}}_{t,m}={\bm{a}}_{t}+\sigma{\bm{\epsilon}}_{m} where ϵ m ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 𝐈 ) {\bm{\epsilon}}_{m}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,{\mathbf{I}}) ,
and average the corresponding flow Jacobians, J ^ t ​ ( 𝒂 t ) = 1 M ​ ∑ m = 1 M J t ​ ( 𝒂 t + σ ​ ϵ m ) , \widehat{J}_{t}({\bm{a}}_{t})=\frac{1}{M}\sum_{m=1}^{M}J_{t}\left({\bm{a}}_{t}+\sigma{\bm{\epsilon}}_{m}\right), (15) where M M denotes the number of particles and σ \sigma controls the local perturbation scale.
Under standard regularity conditions that permit exchanging differentiation and expectation, we have 𝔼 ϵ ​ [ J t ​ ( 𝒂 t + σ ​ ϵ ) ] = ∇ 𝒂 t 𝔼 ϵ ​ [ 𝒗 θ ​ ( 𝒂 t + σ ​ ϵ , 𝒔 , t ) ] \mathbb{E}_{{\bm{\epsilon}}}\left[J_{t}({\bm{a}}_{t}+\sigma{\bm{\epsilon}})\right]=\nabla_{{\bm{a}}_{t}}\mathbb{E}_{{\bm{\epsilon}}}\left[{\bm{v}}_{\theta}({\bm{a}}_{t}+\sigma{\bm{\epsilon}},{\bm{s}},t)\right] .
Thus, J ^ t ​ ( 𝒂 t ) \widehat{J}_{t}({\bm{a}}_{t}) is a Monte Carlo estimate of the Jacobian of a locally Gaussian-smoothed flow field, rather than an ad hoc average of pointwise Jacobians. Because the particles are redrawn independently at each flow step, the resulting target is an unbiased estimate of the costate propagated with the smoothed Jacobian for any M M , and M M only sets its variance (Lemma 1 , Appendix A.2 ).
The adjoint is then propagated as 𝝀 ^ t = ( 𝐈 + Δ ​ t ​ J ^ t ​ ( 𝒂 t ) ) ⊤ ​ 𝝀 ^ t + Δ ​ t , \widehat{{\bm{\lambda}}}_{t}=\left({\mathbf{I}}+\Delta t\widehat{J}_{t}({\bm{a}}_{t})\right)^{\top}\widehat{{\bm{\lambda}}}_{t+\Delta t}, (16) with the same terminal condition 𝝀 ^ 0 = ∇ 𝒂 0 Q π ​ ( 𝒔 , 𝒂 0 ) \widehat{{\bm{\lambda}}}_{0}=\nabla_{{\bm{a}}_{0}}Q^{\pi}({\bm{s}},{\bm{a}}_{0}) .
This smoothing suppresses highly localized Jacobian variations while retaining sensitivity patterns that persist in a neighborhood of the current trajectory.
Accordingly, σ \sigma controls a trade-off between pointwise fidelity and local regularity: as σ → 0 \sigma\rightarrow 0 , the estimator approaches the original pointwise adjoint, while larger σ \sigma provides stronger smoothing of the supervision signal.

blocks.en:
We evaluate AGF on three flow-based VLAs: SmolVLA, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and MolmoAct2, across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro.
On the standard benchmarks, we evaluate SmolVLA ( Shukor et al., 2025 ) on all four LIBERO suites and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) on the atomic suite in RoboCasa.
We further evaluate MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) on LIBERO-Pro, which covers the four LIBERO suites under five visual conditions, and in real-robot manipulation experiments.

我们进一步评价了LIBERO-Pro上的MolmoAct2(Fang等人,2026年),它覆盖了五个视觉条件下的4个LIBERO套房,以及真机器人操纵实验.

We compare AGF with two inference-time critic-guidance methods QDPS and QGF 1 1 1 We consider QPILOTS and GAF as the same variant with QGF since they share the core update rule. , critic-based action selection method called Q-BoN (Best-of- N N ), and policy fine-tuning method QAM. For the details on each baseline methods, please refer to the Appendix B.2.3 .

blocks.en:
Implementation and evaluation. We evaluate SmolVLA ( Shukor et al., 2025 ) on all 10 tasks of each LIBERO suite ( Liu et al., 2023 ) and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) on 18 atomic RoboCasa tasks ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) , with 50 episodes per task and identical episode seeds for paired comparisons.
All inference-time guidance methods freeze the pretrained VLA and share the same task-specific critic, number of action-generation steps, and guidance-weight sweep range, with one weight selected per suite (Table 10 ).
Following prior single-task flow-RL settings ( Doo et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , we train a separate critic ensemble per task, and likewise a separate guidance network per task; the guidance network is trained on the same rollout data used for critic training, requiring no additional data collection. AGF denotes the particle-averaged variant ( M = 4 M=4 , σ = 0.02 \sigma=0.02 ) and M = 1 M=1 the pointwise-adjoint variant.
Training uses 5k rollout updates for SmolVLA and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 1k for MolmoAct2, at roughly 40 minutes per 1k updates on a single RTX 4090. QAM is trained under the same wall-clock budget. Remaining details are in Appendix B , which also compares the QGF and AGF inference procedures (Algorithms 2 , 3 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en:
Critic quality. We first validate whether the trained action-value function assigns meaningful values to each task. We sample actions from the policies used to train the critic and evaluate the rollout. At the end of each scenario, the rollout is labeled as either successful or failed.
Figure 3 shows that the trained critic assigns higher values to successful rollouts than to failed ones.
For successful rollouts, the predicted value increases as the task progresses, while it remains low for failed cases. This outcome-dependent temporal behavior supports the critic as a guidance signal.
blocks.zh:
批评质量. 我们首先验证训练有素的动作值函数是否为每项任务分配有意义的值。 我们从培训批评者和评价推出政策中抽取行动。 在每个方案结束时,推出标注为成功或失败。
图3显示,接受过培训的批评家给成功推出的数值高于失败推出的数值。
为成功推出,预计值随着任务的进展而增加,而失败案件预计值仍然很低。 这种依赖结果的时间行为支持评论家作为指导信号.

blocks.en:
Task performance. Table 2 compares AGF with inference-time critic-guidance, action-selection, and policy-fine-tuning baselines on LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro.
For inference-time methods, we report suite-level calibration, which shares one guidance strength per suite, and task-level calibration, which selects the best strength per task from the sweep and thus serves as a per-task upper bound; strength transfer to genuinely held-out tasks is evaluated by the LOTO protocol below.
Under suite-level calibration, AGF improves the pretrained VLA by 2.6 2.6 – 4.4 4.4 percentage points across the five suites, outperforming Q-BoN on all five and QGF on four while matching or exceeding QDPS throughout.
With task-level calibration, its gains further increase to 4.0 4.0 – 8.4 8.4 points. Compared with QAM, AGF achieves competitive performance without modifying the pretrained policy and retains an adjustable guidance strength at inference.
The same trend holds on LIBERO-Pro with the larger MolmoAct2 backbone. Per-condition results are provided in Appendix C.1 .
QAM, fine-tuned under the same wall-clock budget, falls substantially below the pretrained policy on this 5.5B backbone, which is consistent with its unfavorable training scaling (Figure 4 a), indicating that fine-tuning at this scale requires stabilization beyond matched compute.
Q-BoN is a notable exception, collapsing on MolmoAct2. We attribute this to best-of- N N over-optimization ( Gao et al., 2023 ) : although all actions are sampled from the base policy, the critic is reliable only in regions sufficiently covered by its finite rollout data (Appendix C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
任务性能. 表2将AGF与关于LIBERO、RoboCasa和LIBERO-Pro的推断时间批评指导、行动选择和政策调整基线进行比较。
关于推断时间方法,我们报告套件级校准,每个套件共用一个制导强度,任务级校准,从扫荡中选择每个任务的最佳强度,从而起到每个任务上限的作用;强度转移到真正被持有的任务,由下面的LOTO协议评价.
在套房级校准下,AGF将预训VLA改进2.6 2.6 — 4.4 4.4个百分点跨5套套房,在所有5套房中表现优于Q-BoN,在4套房中表现优于或超过QDPS.
任务级校准后,其收益进一步增加到4.0 4.0 – 8.4 8.4分. 与QAM相比,AGF在不修改预训政策的情况下实现了竞争性的性能,并在推论中保留了可调整的指导力.
LIBERO-Pro也有同样的趋势,拥有更大的MolmoAct2骨干。 附加条件的结果载于附录C.1。
QAM在同一时钟预算下进行了微调,但大大低于这一5.5B主干线上经过预先培训的政策,这与其不利的培训规模一致(图4a),表明在这一规模下微调需要稳定,超出相应的计算。
Q-BON是一个显著的例外,在Molmo Act2上崩溃. 我们将此归因于最佳N N 过度优化(Gao等人,2023年): 尽管所有行动都从基本政策中取样,但批评者只有在其有限推出数据(附录C.2 )充分覆盖的区域才可靠。

blocks.en: Statistical significance. Paired tests over identical episode seeds support these comparisons: AGF significantly improves the pretrained policy ( + 3.6 +3.6 pp pooled over 40 LIBERO tasks, McNemar p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ) and matches QGF ( + 0.7 +0.7 pp in AGF’s favor, p = 0.54 p=0.54 ) at a fraction of its inference cost, with the same pattern on LIBERO-Pro, and directionally, on RoboCasa. Full tests are in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 统计意义. 对相同插曲种子的测试支持这些比较: AGF大大改进了预先训练的政策(+ 3.6 + 3.6页集中了40项LIBERO任务,McNemar p < 10 - 3 p < 10 > → 3}),并以其推论成本的一小部分与QGF(+ 0.7+0.7页,p=0.54 p=0.54)相匹配,在LIBERO-Pro和RoboCasa上模式相同。 全面试验载于附录C.4。

blocks.en:
Calibration transfer. QGF attains the strongest task-level results on the Object and Spatial suites with SmolVLA, but this ordering reverses under suite-level calibration, reflecting AGF’s broad effective scale range (Figure 5 ).
Leave-one-task-out (LOTO) calibration tests this directly: the strength is selected on all but one task and evaluated on the held-out task. AGF outperforms QGF under LOTO on all four suites of LIBERO and atomic tasks of RoboCasa; on four of them it selects the same strength regardless of the held-out task, so its LOTO performance coincides with suite-level calibration. Details are in Appendix C.3 .

留一任务(LOTO)校准直接测试:除一项任务外,所有任务都选择了强度,并评价了被搁置的任务. AGF在LOTO下对LIBERO的所有四个套件和RoboCasa的原子任务的表现都超过了QGF;在其中四个套件上,无论被搁置的任务如何,它都选择相同的强度,因此其LOTO性能与套件级校准一致. 详情见附录C.3。

blocks.en: 4.2 Training and inference efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训和推论效率

blocks.en:
The results above show that AGF matches or outperforms inference-time critic-guidance methods and remains competitive with policy fine-tuning.
AGF reaches this performance at a fraction of their cost: its lightweight guidance design makes both training and inference substantially cheaper than baselines.
Specifically, AGF optimizes only the guidance network while keeping the pretrained VLA frozen.
As a result, it maintains no parameter gradients or optimizer states for the VLA, substantially reducing the training cost.
Figure 4 (a) compares the peak GPU memory and training throughput of AGF and QAM as the batch size increases.
Across VLA backbones, AGF scales to substantially larger batch sizes under the same memory budget. Its throughput also continues to increase with the batch size.
blocks.zh:
以上结果显示,AGF与推论-评论-指导方法相匹配或优于后者,在政策调整方面仍然具有竞争力。
AGF以成本的一小部分达到这种性能:它的轻量级指导设计使培训和推断都比基线便宜得多。
具体来说,AGF只优化引导网络,同时保持预训VLA的冻结.
因此,它没有为VLA保持参数梯度或优化状态,从而大幅降低了培训成本.
图4 (a) 比较AGF和QAM的顶峰GPU内存和培训吞吐量,因为批量尺寸增加。
在整个VLA主干线上,AGF在相同的内存预算下,规模大大扩大。 其吞吐量也随着批量的大小而继续增加.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Weight ablation. Guidance-scale sweep ( 0.25 0.25 – 4.0 4.0 ) for each inference-time method, averaged over all LIBERO suites; AGF consistently improves performance across all scales.
blocks.zh: 图5:体重下降。 指导尺度扫描(0.25 0.25 – 4.0 4.0)每种推论时间方法,平均覆盖所有LIBERO套房;AGF持续改善所有尺度的性能.

blocks.en:
However, the scaling of QAM is limited earlier. This difference becomes bigger for the larger VLA backbone.
Even under parameter-efficient fine-tuning, QAM must back-propagate through both the flow policy and the VLM, storing intermediate activations for the full backbone, whereas AGF only requires action-space vector–Jacobian products of the action expert, never entering the VLM backbone.
blocks.zh:
然而,QAM的缩放在更早的时候是有限的. 对于较大的VLA骨干来说,这种差异变得更加大.
即便在参数高效的微调下,QAM也必须通过流政策和VLM进行后置,存储全主干线的中间激活,而AGF只需要动作空间矢量–动作专家的Jacobian产品,从不进入VLM主干线.

blocks.en:
At inference time, QDPS and QGF evaluate and back-propagate through the critic ensemble at every flow step, whereas AGF requires only a forward pass through the guidance network. As shown in Figure 4 (b), AGF runs 3.6 × 3.6\times faster per guidance step than vectorized QGF and accesses 7.0 × 7.0\times fewer parameters; end-to-end per-chunk overhead measured inside a real control loop is reported in Section 4.4 .
Thus, AGF transfers the expensive critic-gradient computation to a lightweight guidance-network training stage, enabling guidance at deployment without the critic ensemble.
blocks.zh:
在推断时间,QDPS和QGF通过评论者综艺节目在每一流程步骤上进行评价和后置,而AGF只需要通过导线网络的前进. 如图4(b)所示,AGF运行的每个制导步骤比矢量化QGF运行速度快3.6×3.6\时,访问参数减少7.0×7.0\时;在实际控制环内测量的每吨端到端的间接费用在第4.4节中报告.
因此,AGF将昂贵的批评者分级计算转移到轻量级指导网络培训阶段,从而能够在没有评论者组合的情况下进行部署指导。

blocks.en: 4.3 Effective range of guidance strength
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 指导力量的有效范围

blocks.en:
We now examine the effect of the guidance strength, sweeping it from 0.25 0.25 to 4.0 4.0 for both calibration settings, relative to the magnitude of the flow velocity predicted by the pretrained VLA.
Figure 5 shows the average success-rate gain over the pretrained policy across all LIBERO suites; model parameters are fixed within each method, and only the inference-time guidance strength is varied.
QDPS shows no consistent gain and can degrade performance, and QGF peaks at an intermediate scale but fluctuates across the range, whereas AGF (M = = 4) attains positive gains throughout the range, performing best at both the smallest and largest scales.
blocks.zh:
我们现在审查制导强度的效果,对照预先训练的VLA预测的流速大小,将制导强度从0.250.25扫到4.04.0两种校准设置.
图5显示所有LIBERO套房在预训政策之后的平均成功率收益;模型参数在每种方法内固定,只有推论时间指导强度不同。
QDPS显示没有一致的增益,而且能降解性能,QGF在中间尺度上达到峰值,但跨范围波动,而AGF(M = = 4)则在整个范围内取得正增益,在最小和最大尺度上都表现最好.

blocks.en: 4.4 Real Robot Experiment
blocks.zh: 4.4 真正的机器人实验

blocks.en: We verify the proposed AGF pipeline, including critic training, guidance network training, and deployment without the critic ensemble, on the real hardware setup. In particular, we examine whether AGF improves the base VLA effectively without carrying the critic ensemble and backpropagating it at deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们核实拟议的AGF管道,包括评论员培训、指导网络培训,以及在没有评论员合唱团的情况下部署真正的硬件设置。 特别是,我们审查AGF是否有效地改进了VLA基地,而没有在部署时携带批评者综艺节目和反宣传节目。

blocks.en:
Setup. We adopt the real-robot setup of MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) , a YAM 6-DoF arm with a parallel-jaw gripper and two RGB cameras, and evaluate on two manipulation tasks, one short (“Pick up the ball and place it on the plate.”) and one long task (“Open the box, put the ball inside, and close it”). Critics and guidance networks are trained on robot rollouts following the same procedure as in simulation.
Guidance strengths are likewise transferred from simulation without on-robot tuning: each method uses the strength that maximizes its average gain in the simulation sweep (Figure 5 ; w = 1 w=1 for QGF, w = 4 w=4 for AGF).
We compare Base, QGF, and AGF over 50 paired episodes for a short task, and 25 paired episodes for a long task; the full protocol is in Appendix B.3 .

Results. Table 3 reports success rates and per-chunk guidance overhead measured during the rollouts on the same RTX 4090.
Both methods are deployed under the same no-tuning protocol: each transfers its simulation-selected strength without any on-robot calibration.
Under this protocol, AGF significantly improves the base VLA without carrying the critic ensemble at deployment, whereas QGF’s transferred strength yields no measurable gain, consistent with its fluctuating response to the guidance strength in simulation (Figure 5 ).
The paired gap between the two is itself significant ( + 16.0 +16.0 pp in AGF’s favor, p = 0.004 p{=}0.004 ): live critic guidance would require on-robot strength calibration to be effective, which is precisely the per-deployment cost that inference-time guidance is meant to avoid, whereas AGF transfers directly.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We propose AGF, which formulates critic guidance for a frozen flow policy as deterministic optimal control and regresses a lightweight network onto the resulting costate, the exact value gradient of the executed action.
On LIBERO, RoboCasa, and LIBERO-Pro, AGF improves every pretrained VLA, matches live critic guidance and policy fine-tuning, keeps its gains under a single deployed strength, and carries a simulation-chosen strength to a real robot, while removing the critic ensemble and all back-propagation from the control loop. We discuss limitations and future directions in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
我们提议采用AGF,为冻结流动政策制定批评性指导,作为确定性的最佳控制,并将一个轻量级网络倒退到由此产生的成本,即被执行行动的确切价值梯度。
在LIBERO,RoboCasa,和LIBERO-Pro上,AGF改进了每款预训VLA,匹配了现场评论家指导和政策微调,将其收益保持在单一部署的强度下,并携带模拟选择的强度给真正的机器人,同时将评论家综艺和所有反向传播从控制循环中移除. 我们在附录D中讨论了限制和未来方向。

blocks.en: Q-BoN (Best-of- N N ). Q-BoN applies the critic only at the terminal step. Q-BoN requires no back-propagation and uses intermediate generation as is, but its per-step cost scales linearly with N N . Analogously to the guidance-weight sweep of the gradient-based methods, we sweep N ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } N\in\{4,8,16\} and select the best value per suite; the selected values are listed in Table 10 .

blocks.en: QAM. QAM ( Li and Levine, 2026 ) amortizes the critic signal into the policy itself: the flow policy is fine-tuned with adjoint-matching supervision so that no critic is needed at inference. We fine-tune the policy with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) (rank 16) using AdamW with learning rate 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and gradient clipping at norm 1.0 1.0 , for 4,000 steps under the same wall-clock budget as AGF training. Since the guidance strength is absorbed into the fine-tuned weights, QAM has no inference-time hyperparameter and reports a single result across both calibration settings.

blocks.en:
Robot setup. Apart from the task set, we follow the real-robot setup of MolmoAct2 ( Fang et al., 2026 ) : a YAM 6-DoF robot arm equipped with a parallel-jaw gripper, resulting in a 7-dimensional action space (six joint positions and one gripper command). The platform is bimanual, but we use it in a single-arm configuration and control only the right arm throughout data collection and evaluation.
The policy observes two RGB camera views (top and right) together with the robot’s proprioceptive state, and receives a language instruction describing the task.
Raw joint states and teleoperation commands are recorded at approximately 200Hz and linearly interpolated onto the 30Hz camera timestamps, so all training and evaluation data are at 30Hz.
At deployment, the policy runs in a 30Hz control loop and predicts 30-step action chunks (1s). Chunks are generated asynchronously: a new chunk is requested every 0.5s and, once available, replaces the remaining action queue, so roughly 15 steps of each chunk are executed under nominal inference latency.
All policies run on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090, and all latencies are measured on the same machine.
blocks.zh:
机器人设置. 除了任务设定之外,我们遵循MolmoAct2(Fang et al., 2026)的真机器人设置:一个YAM 6-DoF机器人臂,配备了平行的jaw gripper,从而形成了一个7维的动作空间(6个联合位置和1个jripper命令). 该平台是双人平台,但我们使用它进行单臂配置,在整个数据收集和评估过程中只控制右臂.
政策观察两个RGB摄像头(顶部和右部)以及机器人的自控状态,并收到描述任务的语言指示.
原始联合状态和远程操作命令记录在大约200Hz,线性插入30Hz相机时间戳,因此所有训练和评价数据都位于30Hz.
部署时,政策运行在30Hz控制循环中,并预测30步动作块(1s). 块是同步生成的:每0.5秒请求一个新的块,一旦可用,就替换剩余的动作队列,因此每个块的大约15个步骤都会在名义推论延迟下执行.
所有政策都运行在单一的NVIDIA RTX 4090上,所有延迟都是在同一台机器上测量的.

blocks.en:
Dataset and training. We collect approximately 100 episodes for each of four tasks (eight data-collection variants differing in object instances, e.g., different balls for pnp-plate , grouped into four tasks). The exact statistics are in Table 5 .
We fully fine-tune MolmoAct2 (starting from allenai/MolmoAct2-BimanualYAM ; all parameters updated except the
frozen embeddings) on the collected demonstrations through behavior cloning, using AdamW (lr 10 − 5 10^{-5} , cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} with 200-step warmup, no weight decay) with batch size 108 for 20,000 steps on a single B200 GPU and standard image augmentations (color jitter, sharpness jitter, random affine within ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} and ± 5 % \pm 5\% translation); we use the checkpoint at 14,000 steps.
Following the per-task protocol of the simulated experiments, critics and guidance networks are trained for the two evaluation tasks, using rollouts of the fine-tuned policy on each task.
The critic takes the full 29-step action chunk as input (Table 4 ) 2 2 2 While the policy predicts 30-step chunks, the longest executed action sequence observed in the recorded data was 29 steps, so we set the critic horizon to 29 accordingly. . Because a new chunk replaces the action queue roughly every 0.5s under asynchronous execution, the recorded per-chunk action sequences are typically 15–20 steps rather than the full 29; we pad them to 29 steps by repeating the last predicted action. Discarding incomplete chunks instead would remove nearly all records, including the terminal ones where success and failure signals concentrate.
The two evaluation tasks are “pick up the ball and place it on the plate” ( pnp-plate ), where a black ball must be picked and placed onto a plate, and “open the box, put the ball inside, and close it” ( open-pnp-close ), a long-horizon sequence in which the robot opens a box, picks and places the black ball inside, and closes the box.

Evaluation details. pnp-plate is evaluated over 50 paired episodes and open-pnp-close over 25, with a time limit of 30s for pnp-plate and 45s for open-pnp-close .
Episodes differ in their initial configuration: the ball and plate positions vary across pnp-plate episodes, and the ball position varies across open-pnp-close episodes. All methods are nevertheless evaluated on the same set of initial configurations, enabling paired comparison.
We report the success rate (%). For pnp-plate , an episode is successful once the ball lies entirely on the plate and the gripper has opened. For open-pnp-close , an episode is successful only if the ball is placed inside the box and the box is fully closed.
Latencies are measured with CUDA synchronization inside the deployed control loop (10 denoising steps, two 480 × 640 480{\times}640 camera views), with each method at its deployed strength; QGF uses a vectorized (vmap) critic-ensemble implementation.

Table 6 reports the per-condition LIBERO-Pro breakdown; the suite-averaged MolmoAct2 results correspond to the LIBERO-Pro rows of Table 2 .
The Clean and Semantic conditions are near saturation for MolmoAct2, leaving little room for guidance, whereas the gains of all guidance methods concentrate on the harder conditions, most notably Position, where AGF ( M = 4 M=4 ) improves the pretrained policy from 23.0 to 27.0 under task-level calibration.
Across all five conditions, AGF remains on par with QDPS and QGF under both calibration settings, extending the suite-level observation of Section 4 to individual visual perturbations.
Q-BoN collapses uniformly across conditions; we analyze this failure in Appendix C.2 .

blocks.en: C.2 Q-BoN Over-optimization on MolmoAct2
blocks.zh: C.2 Q-BoN 过量优化 Mollmo Act2

blocks.en:
On MolmoAct2, Q-BoN collapses across all four LIBERO-Pro suites (Table 2 ), although the same critic provides effective guidance for QGF and AGF. We verified that Q-BoN uses the same critic checkpoint and pessimistic aggregation, with the correct ranking polarity and independently sampled candidates.
The failure instead arises from best-of- N N over-optimization. QGF and AGF make local corrections around the base-policy trajectory, where the critic is sufficiently supported by its finite rollout data.
In contrast, maximizing over N N independent samples increasingly favors low-density candidates with positive value-estimation errors, resulting in actions that score highly under the critic but fail in execution.
blocks.zh:
在Molmo Act2上,Q-BON在全部四个LIBERO-Pro套房中崩溃(表2),虽然同一评论家为QGF和AGF提供了有效的指导. 我们核实,Q-BON使用同样的批评者检查站和悲观汇总,正确的排名极性和独立抽查的候选人.
相反,失败来自最佳NN过度优化。 QGF和AGF围绕基本政策轨迹进行局部校正,批评者在其有限的推出数据中得到充分的支持.
相比之下,N独立标本的最大化越来越倾向于有正值估计错误的低密度候选人,导致行动在批评者之下得分很高但执行失败.

blocks.en: C.3 Leave-One-Task-Out Calibration
blocks.zh: C.3 一个任务外校准

blocks.en: Suite-level calibration in Table 2 selects a single guidance strength using all tasks within a suite. While this evaluates whether one shared strength can work across heterogeneous tasks, each task still contributes to the selection, so it does not directly measure transfer to a task unseen during calibration.
blocks.zh: 表2中的套装级校准使用套装内的所有任务选择单一的制导强度. 虽然这可以评估一个共享的力量是否能够在各种任务之间发挥作用,但每项任务仍然有助于选择,因此它不会直接衡量在校准过程中无法预见的任务转移情况。

blocks.en: To evaluate this setting, we conduct a leave-one-task-out (LOTO) test: for each task in a suite, the guidance strength is selected to maximize the average success rate over the remaining tasks and evaluated on the held-out task, with results averaged over all held-out tasks. We reuse the per-task success rates from the guidance-strength sweep in Appendix C.5 , and each method selects within its own sweep range.
blocks.zh: 为了评价这一设置,我们进行了一个 " 留守一任务 " (LOTO)测试:针对每套任务,选择指导力量,以尽量扩大剩余任务的平均成功率,并对被搁置任务进行评价,结果平均适用于所有被搁置任务。 我们重新使用附录C.5中指导强度扫描的每个任务成功率,每种方法在自己的扫描范围内选择。

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the results. On the LIBERO and RoboCasa atomic tasks, AGF outperforms QGF on every held-out suite. Its advantage comes from stability rather than peak performance: on most suites AGF selects the same strength regardless of which task is held out, so excluding a task from calibration costs it almost nothing, whereas QGF loses a larger share of its task-level gains once per-task selection is unavailable, which is consistent with its fluctuating response to the guidance strength (Figure 5 ). On LIBERO-Pro with MolmoAct2 (right block), the two methods remain comparable under LOTO, mirroring their suite-level parity in Table 2 , and both degrade only mildly from task-level calibration. LIBERO-10 is the exception in both settings, where task heterogeneity makes any single shared strength less effective. Overall, AGF is ahead on the large majority of the nine LOTO comparisons, and the results support suite-level calibration as a practical proxy for deployment to unseen tasks without task-specific strength selection.

blocks.zh: C.4 重要测试

blocks.en:
All comparisons use the suite-level calibration weights of Table 10 and are episode-level paired tests: both methods are evaluated on identical episode seeds on all three benchmarks: LIBERO (10 tasks × \times 50 episodes per suite, SmolVLA), RoboCasa (18 atomic tasks × \times 50 episodes, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ), and LIBERO-Pro (10 tasks × \times 5 conditions × \times 10 episodes per suite, MolmoAct2), with a single training seed throughout; AGF denotes the M = 4 M{=}4 variant as in the main text.
Each episode seed fixes both the initial action noise and the environment initialization, and for each task all methods are evaluated on the same RTX 4090 to avoid hardware-dependent nondeterminism, so that per-episode outcomes are directly comparable across methods.
We report the mean success-rate difference Δ \Delta SR (percentage points, positive favors AGF), exact McNemar p p -values, and 95% paired bootstrap confidence intervals (20,000 resamples), per suite and pooled within each benchmark.
Pooled over suites, AGF’s improvement over the pretrained policy is significant on LIBERO and LIBERO-Pro and directionally positive on RoboCasa, while AGF and QGF are statistically indistinguishable on every suite of every benchmark.

blocks.en: C.6 Subtask analysis for real robot long task
blocks.zh: C.6 真正的机器人长任务子任务分析

blocks.en:
We evaluate AGF on the real-robot system with two tasks: a short pick-and-place ( pnp-plate ) and a long compositional task ( open-pnp-close ) consisting of three subtasks: open the box, place the ball inside, and close the box.
For the compositional task, Table 11 scores each subtask independently over the 25 paired episodes.
AGF improves every subtask over the base policy and completes all 25 opening attempts, while the base policy frequently skips or fails intermediate subtasks (e.g., closing the box without placing the ball), which the independent scoring makes visible.
QGF’s transferred strength improves opening and placing only marginally and does not improve closing, consistent with its overall lack of gain on this task (Table 3 ).

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en:
AGF inherits two dependencies from its design.
First, following the single-task critic setting of prior work, each task requires training its own critic ensemble and guidance network. The critic is shared with every guidance baseline; the guidance network is the additional cost AGF pays to remove the critic from deployment, paid once per task rather than once per episode. Amortizing guidance across tasks with a shared network remains an open direction.
Second, the quality of the guidance is bounded by the quality of the critic: AGF distills the critic’s gradient signal and cannot correct for a poorly calibrated value function.
Finally, on suites with highly heterogeneous tasks such as LIBERO-10, any single deployed guidance strength degrades from per-task calibration (Appendix C.3 ), suggesting that strength selection itself could benefit from state-dependent adaptation.
blocks.zh:
AGF从它的设计中继承了两个依赖性.
首先,在单任务评论家设定先前的工作之后,每项任务都需要培训自己的评论家综艺和指导网络。 批评者与每个指导基线共享;指导网络是AGF为了让批评者退出部署而支付的额外费用,每个任务支付一次,而不是每集一次. 利用一个共同的网络,在各项任务之间分摊指导仍然是开放的方向。
第二,指导的质量以评论家的品质为界:AGF提炼评论家的梯度信号,无法校正校准的值函数.
最后,在LiBERO-10等任务高度多样化的套房中,任何单一部署的制导强度都会从每任务校准(附录C.3)中降解,这表明实力选择本身可以得益于国家的依赖性改造.
